description_en: Queries the instance status details of a change tracking channel. This is a legacy operation
description_zh: 老版查看订阅通道实例状态详情
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-subscription-instance-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsy0zz3t13h7d0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSubscriptionInstanceStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

BeginTimestamp.description_en: The beginning of the timestamp range for data stored in the change tracking instance. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
BeginTimestamp.description_zh: 订阅实例中保存的数据范围的起始时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_en: The consumption checkpoint of the change tracking instance. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_zh: 订阅实例的下游消费时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ConsumptionClient.description_en: The information about the downstream consumption client, which consists of an IP address and a random number generated by DTS
ConsumptionClient.description_zh: 下游消费客户端信息，由IP地址和DTS随机生成的随机数组成

EndTimestamp.description_en: The end of the timestamp range for data stored in the change tracking instance. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
EndTimestamp.description_zh: 订阅实例中保存的数据范围的截止时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the change tracking task is abnormal
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 数据订阅异常的错误提示
ErrorMessage.example: Original error: Access denied for user 'dtstest'@'100.104.***.**' (using password:                              YES)

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the change tracking instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
订阅实例的付费类型，返回值：
PrePaid：包年包月（预付费）。
PostPaid：按量付费（后付费）

SourceEndpoint.description_en: The connection information of the source instance

InstanceID.description_en: The instance ID of the source database

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type of the source database.
This parameter is returned only when the change tracking instance is of the new version
InstanceType.description_zh:
源库的实例类型。
当该订阅实例为新版时，才会返回该参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the change tracking instance. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Prechecking: running a precheck.
PrecheckFailed: precheck failed.
Starting: starting.
Normal: running normally.
Abnormal: abnormal
Status.description_zh:
订阅实例的状态，返回值：

NotStarted：未启动。
Prechecking：预检查中。
PrecheckFailed：预检查失败。
Starting：启动中。
Normal：正常。
Abnormal：异常

SubscribeTopic.description_en:
The subscription topic.
This parameter is returned only when the change tracking instance is of the new version and a consumer group is created by calling the [CreateConsumerGroup]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122863.html） operation
SubscribeTopic.description_zh:
订阅Topic。
当该订阅实例为新版，且调用[CreateConsumerGroup]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122863.html）接口创建了消费组时，才会返回本参数

SubscriptionDataType.description_en: The type of the subscribed data

DDL.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscribed data includes DDL statements. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
DDL.description_zh:
订阅数据是否包含DDL语句，返回值：

true：是。
false：否

DML.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscribed data includes DML statements. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
DML.description_zh:
订阅数据是否包含DML语句，返回值：

true：是。
false：否

SubscriptionHost.description_en: The endpoint of the change tracking instance

PrivateHost.description_en: The private endpoint of the change tracking instance, in the format of `address:port`
PrivateHost.description_zh: 订阅实例的私网连接信息，格式为`地址：端口号`

PublicHost.description_en: The public endpoint of the subscribe instance, in the format of `address:port`
PublicHost.description_zh: 订阅实例的公网连接信息，格式为`地址：端口号`

VPCHost.description_en: The VPC endpoint of the change tracking instance, in the format of `address:port`
VPCHost.description_zh: 订阅实例的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接信息，格式为`地址：端口号`

SubscriptionInstanceID.description_en: The ID of the change tracking instance

SubscriptionInstanceName.description_en: The name of the change tracking instance

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the change tracking task
